name: mySum_append
prelude:
def mySum : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + mySum xs
statement: theorem mySum_append (xs ys : List Nat) : mySum (xs ++ ys) = mySum xs + mySum ys
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => simp [mySum]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [mySum, ih, Nat.add_assoc]
  induction xs with
  | nil => rw [List.nil_append, mySum, Nat.zero_add]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.cons_append, mySum, mySum, ih]
    omega
